# Changelog

## [1.0.1] – **Alpha**

### Added
- Java 21 LTS is now required for building and running the mod.
- Updated documentation and setup instructions for Java 21 and Gradle 8.8+.
- Enhanced World Selector and Admin Dashboard GUIs with modern styling, improved navigation, and permission-based features.

### Changed
- Upgraded Gradle wrapper and build scripts for full Java 21 compatibility.
- Improved `/timedharvest create` command: now supports full customization (world type, seed, border, structures).
- Improved in-game help and troubleshooting commands.

### Fixed
- Automatic configuration validation and auto-fix for common setup issues.
- More robust error messages for invalid dimension names and configuration problems.

---

**Upgrade Note:**  
You must use Java 21+ to build and run this version. See the updated README for details.

releases.notes:
## 🎉 Features

### GUI System
- **Player World Selector** (`/th`) - Professional interface with yellow title bar and navigation
- **Admin Dashboard** (`/th admin`) - Visual management interface for operators
  - Left-click worlds to view commands
  - Right-click worlds to toggle enabled/disabled
  - Real-time GUI updates
- **Permission-Based UI** - Admin features only visible to operators (permission level 2+)
- **Arrow Navigation** - Smooth pagination for unlimited worlds
- **Page Indicators** - Current/total page display

### World Management
- **Automatic World Resets** - Configure reset intervals in hours
- **Custom Dimensions** - Support for overworld, nether, and end world types
- **Unique Seed Generation** - Automatic random seeds or custom-defined
- **World Borders** - Configurable size limits for performance
- **Structure Generation** - Toggle structure spawning per world

### Commands
- `/th` - Open world selector GUI
- `/th admin` - Open admin dashboard (operators only)
- `/timedharvest create` - Full world customization with all parameters
- `/timedharvest tp <worldId>` - Teleport to resource worlds
- `/timedharvest help troubleshooting` - Common fixes and dimension naming guide

### Quality of Life
- **Player Notifications** - Countdown warnings before resets (60, 30, 10, 5, 1 minute)
- **Tab Completion** - Smart command suggestions
- **Dimension Validation** - Prevents invalid dimension names with helpful errors
- **JSON Configuration** - Easy-to-edit config with auto-validation
- **Persistent State** - Survives server restarts

## 🛠️ Technical

- Built for Minecraft 1.20.1
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.15.11+
- Requires Fabric API 0.92.2+
- Java 21 compatible
- Server-side focused (works in single-player)

## 📝 Notes

This is the initial stable release with full GUI management, admin dashboard, and comprehensive world customization options.
